core_obligations: Reduce to affine opens where the naive cotangent complex computes NL.
Translate amplitude conditions between complexes and the derived-category dictionary.
difficulty_reason: For a perfect morphism f : X -> Y of locally Noetherian schemes the lemma gives the three-way equivalence: f is a local complete intersection morphism; NL_{X/Y} has tor-amplitude in [-1, 0]; NL_{X/Y} is perfect with tor-amplitude in [-1, 0]. The retained proof is written as the affines-to-schemes translation protocol: the chapter's lci-affine dictionary (lemma affine-lci) identifies lci-ness with the finite tor dimension condition on the naive cotangent complex of a polynomial presentation; the identification NL_{X/Y} with that naive complex on affines (chapter lemma NL-affine); the Derived Categories of Schemes comparison trio (affine-compare-bounded, tor-dimension-affine, perfect-affine) turns the module-theoretic amplitude statements into the scheme-global ones; and the resulting ring-level theorem is Divided Power Algebra, lemma perfect-NL-lci (a perfect map is lci iff its naive cotangent complex has tor-amplitude in [-1,0]). Every input is a named bridge. Retained author proof at lines 18488-18498.

dedup.scope: Tor-amplitude lci characterization for perfect morphisms in the Noetherian setting.
